title: The Journey of Abraham
note: The traditional route of Abraham's migration (Genesis 11–13). Ur and Haran are located by tradition and scholarly proposal; the biblical text gives the stages, not a surveyed road.

points.note: Abraham's traditional birthplace, in southern Mesopotamia (its identification is debated).
Where Terah's family settled, and Abraham received the call to go on (Gen 12:1).
He pitched his tent and called on the name of the LORD (Gen 12:8).
Settled by the oaks of Mamre; the cave of Machpelah became the family burial place.
He went down to Egypt in a famine, then returned (Gen 12:10–13:1).
